name: EchoBrief
subtitle: Meetings into reviewed actions
promotionalText: Turn a meeting transcript into a local brief and source-linked commitments you can verify.
description:
Turn a meeting transcript into a local brief and source-linked commitments you can verify.

Use text, an imported transcript or a consented local recording to prepare a meeting brief. On-device audio transcription uses English (U.S.) when available; you can paste and edit a transcript instead.

Review summaries, meeting-cost assumptions and each commitment beside its source quote.

Confirm the owner, task and date before creating a system reminder or calendar event.

Export a meeting brief PDF for a destination you select.

Search your saved library locally. Export a complete portable backup with optional password encryption; imports add new identifiers and keep existing edited records.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Document processing and supported Apple Intelligence generation run on device. Optional storage uses your private iCloud container. There is no developer-operated account, advertising, analytics backend or third-party AI API. Supported local/text workflows remain available when a model or speech language is unavailable.

FREE AND PRO
Includes five successful on-device AI actions in total per app. Reading, editing, exporting and backing up saved records remain available without Pro. Pro unlocks additional actions through monthly or annual subscriptions, or a separate lifetime purchase. App Store prices, eligibility and subscription terms are displayed before purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled in App Store settings.

Obtain participant consent before recording. On-device speech recognition requires a supported language and device. Relative dates remain unset until verified. Cost estimates depend on the rates and attendance you enter. The app does not message meeting participants.
